propositions: Default run_in_worker uses fork on POSIX hosts, triggering CPython 3.12+ DeprecationWarning when background threads exist, because multiprocessing.get_context('fork') is hardcoded at harness.py:254-267
Spawn context preserves 46/47 existing lifecycle tests; only one reap-lag test fails due to unpicklable local closure attached to Process before start

Worker callables must be importable module-level names with pickleable args, kwargs, and return values under spawn; fork context allowed dynamic closures/lambdas which masked serialization requirements
Process construction, start, pickling, and parent receive/unpickling failures must return RunResult(abstain_reason='other') without raising, implementing fail-open contract
Explicit multiprocessing context injection allows informed callers to opt into fork for legacy/frozen-executable compatibility while owning thread-safety risk
